note: A WEARABLE verdict requires out.issues.length === 0 AND the drafted spec faithfully matching the flat. PARTIAL = drafts wearable but drops features the flat clearly has, OR drafts with a wearability issue. OUT-OF-SCOPE = engine cannot represent this garment class. Pattern-pieces sheets and blank/junk images are skipped (not garment flats).

issues: [sideseam] Top: front side seam 324.9 vs back 350.4

learnings.capability: Bodice/skirt YOKE split (curved horizontal yoke seam, skirt or lower body gathered into it)
learnings.note: Most frequent silhouette the engine can only approximate. Doll/babydoll/swing garments hang from a yoke seam, not from a full-length darted bodice.

learnings.capability: Shaped hems beyond straight/shirttail/highLow: pointed/dipped corset waist hem, inverted BOX PLEAT at hem
learnings.note: hemShape enum lacks pointed-V and pleated hems.

learnings.capability: ASYMMETRIC PLACKET on garment=top is a WEARABILITY BUG, not a gap
learnings.note: placketStyle:2 on a top always yields front side seam ~25mm shorter than back (unwearable). Works fine on a dress. Round-2 FIX candidate: the placket's front-length extension is applied to dress but not top side-seam balancing. Reproduce: garment=top + placketStyle:2 => [sideseam] issue every time.

learnings.capability: Playsuit / romper garment class (bodice joined to shorts, crotch construction)
learnings.note: garment enum is skirt/dress/top only. No leg/crotch. Whole class unrepresentable.

learnings.capability: Boned corsetry (boning channels, lace-up eyelet closure, underwire cup engineering)
learnings.note: Structured foundation-wear. cupSeam exists but no boning/lacing/cup-cage. Forcing it would produce a non-functional 'corset'.

learnings.capability: Oversized / statement collar sizing; welt/flap pocket construction
learnings.note: Minor fidelity gaps — garments still draft wearable, but the feature the flat is 'about' is substituted.
